checks.name: short-shutter admission accepts exact endpoint and rejects every longer represented candidate exposure
force boundary and source birth cuts preserve exact represented clocks, order, duration and metadata
tail cuts are shifted by physical lag once and remain independent of wind update count

evidence.policy: force-only partitions; within-piece wind midpoint approximation

checks.name: invalid or unresolved subintervals and explicit partition overflow fail without truncation
all 32 native motors retain at most three force portions across admitted short exposures
positive head/tail temporal weights conserve reference RGB and query only strict causal midpoints
future and prebirth support are rejected before any physical anchor callback
source transmission accepts exactly 18000 rows while packet and pair caps remain unchanged
CPU-only FW fill admits all 18000 rows and rejects 18001 without clipping or drawing
main lens rejects long exposures with configured or active motors before any setting mutation
main candidate configuration and launch reject unsupported shutter before effects/UI/state mutate
main explicit random+candidate request rejects before resetting the selected profile
main native source-transmission allocation changes source count only

limits: No actual WebGL context, browser, GPU compilation, texture sampling or frame-time admission.
Force-only temporal partition; actual anchors retain committed wind, with within-piece wind derivative jumps approximated at local midpoint.
Positive source-only subinterval weights do not integrate camera motion or time-varying source transmission T(t).
Exact main function slices run in isolated CPU stubs; full browser UI binding remains root acceptance.
